scan.title: Scanning the phone
scan.sub: This takes a few seconds. Keep the cable connected.

who.hint: Reproduce the problem on the phone (e.g. unlock and wait for the ad), then click.
who.overlays_unknown: Could not read windows over other apps.
who.unknown: Could not tell which app is in the foreground.

incident.hint: Reproduce the problem; when the ad appears on the phone, click “The ad is on screen now”.
incident.mark: The ad is on screen now
incident.none: No ad moment was marked — nothing attributed.
incident.undetermined: Undetermined — the screen was not read near the mark.
incident.next_scan: The next scan of this phone uses the recording (for 24 h). A window alone does not prove it showed the ad.

summary.low_data: Little behavior data ({hours} h of statistics or a recent reboot) — use the phone for a few minutes, reproduce the problem and scan again, or use “Find the ad source”.
summary.profiles: The phone has other user profiles ({ids}) — their apps were not checked.
summary.profiles_unknown: Could not read the list of user profiles — only the main profile was checked; apps in other profiles (e.g. a work profile) may have been missed.
summary.incomplete: Incomplete assessment — could not read: {names}. Apps affected: {count}. “Without issues” here only means “no signs in the data that was read”.
summary.notifications_manual: Android 12 and older: app notifications cannot be turned off from the computer — only by hand on the phone (Settings › Apps › the app › Notifications). “Silence” stops the app and takes away e.g. the home screen role, notification access and drawing over other apps.
summary.select_level_disable: The default action from settings (“Silence”) is replaced with “Disable” on this phone.
summary.checks_unreadable: Could not read the phone state (site notifications in browsers). An empty list does not mean there is nothing there — check by hand in the browser settings.

short.incomplete: Incomplete assessment — some data could not be read.
short.profiles: Other user profiles were not checked.
short.profiles_unknown: Could not read the list of user profiles.
short.notifications_manual: Android 12: notifications can only be turned off on the phone.
short.select_level_disable: The default “Silence” is replaced with “Disable” here.

evidence.title: App details
evidence.none: Select an app in the table.
evidence.deep_hint: Looks in the app code for possible paths to sensitive calls. Takes up to a few minutes.
evidence.incomplete_data: Little data about the app's behavior

plan.title: Repair plan
plan.confirm_title: What I will do on the phone
plan.unlock_prompt: This is a system app — changing it can break phone features. To unlock it, type the package name: {package}
plan.undo_hint: You can undo changes in History. Removing an app deletes its data — undo restores the app itself.
plan.nothing: Nothing to run — all apps are blocked.
plan.share_hint: The list will be encrypted and stored on the AdMeNot server for an hour. Only this code can read it.
plan.share_qr: QR code with the repair plan for the client
plan.share_local: No connection to the server. The code works without icons. We will keep trying to send the full plan in the background.
plan.share_upgraded: Code updated, now with icons. The list has not changed (code {code}).
plan.share_too_long: No connection to the server, and the plan is too long for a code without internet.
plan.share_local_server: The AdMeNot server did not accept the plan. The code works without icons. We will keep trying to send the full plan in the background.
plan.share_too_long_server: The AdMeNot server did not accept the plan, and the plan is too long for a code without internet.
plan.share_error: The code for the client could not be prepared.
plan.consent: The client has seen the scope of the repair (code {code})
plan.changed: The plan has changed since it was shown to the client. Show the client the new code.

user.channel_all: On the phone, turn off the notifications switch for all sites ({browser})

welcome.title: Welcome to AdMeNot
welcome.lead: Before you start, read what you are agreeing to.
welcome.risk1: AdMeNot is a beta and may contain bugs.
welcome.risk2: The program disables and removes apps on the customer's phone. Every change is your decision, and you answer for it to the customer.
welcome.risk3: You can undo most changes in History. Removing an app deletes its data — undo restores at most the app itself from the APK copy.
welcome.risk4: Back up the customer's important data before a repair.
welcome.risk5: The program is provided “as is”, without any warranty (PolyForm Shield 1.0.0 license).
welcome.later: You can change your choices at any time in Settings.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.telemetry_hint: They show which phones reach repair shops and whether detection gets it right. No serial numbers, IMEI or customer data.
privacy.packages: Include package names of flagged and removed apps
privacy.packages_hint: This helps improve detection the most. The name of a rare app may, however, say something about the customer.

what.common: Always: a random installation ID, program and Windows version, language, hour of the event.
what.start: Program start (at most once a day): simple or expert mode.
what.scan: After a scan: phone manufacturer, model and Android version, number of apps per rating, scan time, APK analysis result.
what.repair: After a repair: how many apps were silenced, disabled and removed, how many the program flagged, how many failed and the error codes.
what.undo: After an undo: how many apps were restored and how many days after the repair.
what.transfer_backup: After copying an old phone's data: phone manufacturer, model and Android version, outcome, duration, size in MB, number of copied and failed files and apps, which kinds of data were selected — no folder, file or app names.
what.packages: With the second consent: package names of apps the program flagged or you selected, with the rating and your decision.
what.never: Never: serial number, IMEI, customer name, order number, shop details, screenshots, names of apps rated safe and left untouched.

privacy.id_hint: Include it in an email if you want your data deleted. Turning statistics off deletes the data from the server.
privacy.delete_pending: Deleting data from the server is waiting for an internet connection.

donate.title: Support the project
donate.already: I already support it, don't show again
donate.banner: AdMeNot is free and made by one person. If it saves you time in your shop, you can buy me a coffee — it's voluntary and unlocks nothing.
donate.settings_text: AdMeNot is free. Voluntary support helps develop it and unlocks nothing.

history.title: Order history
history.delete_text: Its steps, screenshots, report and APK copies will be removed. Changes on the phone can no longer be undone in AdMeNot.
history.admin_note: Undo does not restore device admin rights.
history.banner: The order from {when} was not finished
history.restoring: Installing the app from the backup on this computer ({size}) — this can take up to a minute. Keep the phone connected.
history.sites_rest: Turn the rest on from the order history.
history.open_site: Open the site on the phone
history.sites_resubscribe: Permission is back, but the site has to subscribe the phone again — open it (sometimes you need to click “Subscribe” or “Allow” there).
history.open_site_failed: Couldn't open the site on the phone.

undo.sites_sub: Turn the switches on one by one on the phone — the next one opens by itself.

mirror.missing: Screen view unavailable: bundled scrcpy is missing (run scripts\fetch_tools.py).
mirror.blocked_title: Screen view works, but the phone blocks control.
mirror.blocked_text: On Xiaomi, turn on “USB debugging (Security settings)” in developer options, then close and reopen the screen view.
mirror.awake_blocked: The phone screen may turn off: the phone did not let it stay on. On OPPO and realme turn on “Disable permission monitoring” in developer options, on Xiaomi “USB debugging (Security settings)”.

settings.title: Settings
settings.adb_hint: Empty = adb bundled with the program (or adb from PATH without it)
settings.select_level: Action when an app is selected
settings.select_level_hint: Applies to apps the program proposes nothing for (e.g. “Review”). Manufacturer apps are not removed by default — they get “Disable”.
settings.mirror_auto: Open the screen view when a phone is connected
settings.mirror_auto_hint: The screen view shows the customer's phone screen — turn this on only if you work this way.
settings.check_updates_hint: Off: the program never contacts the server and will not learn about a new or withdrawn version.
settings.retention_hint: 60 days by default. Orders (with the customer name, IMEI, screenshots and APK copies) are deleted when the program starts. Orders with steps left to finish are kept. Deleted orders can no longer be undone. Technical logs are kept for 90 days.
settings.logo_hint: PNG, JPG, WebP or SVG, up to 1 MB.
settings.cache_limit_bad: The limit cannot be larger than the disk or smaller than 1 GB.
settings.cache_status_effective: · room now for {effective} GB (free {free} GB − 2 GB reserve)
settings.cache_clear_after: Clear the APK cache after a finished repair
settings.cache_clear_after_hint: Backups of removed apps are kept.

console.disabled: The console works with a scanned phone while no order is running.

crash.title: Send an error report
crash.intro: The report goes to the author of the program and helps fix this error.
crash.includes: Contains: program and Windows versions, the error description, the phone model.

crash.adb: Include the last ADB commands (may contain names of apps on the customer's phone)
crash.contact: Want a reply? Write to e.wlodarski@protonmail.com and give the report number.
crash.queued: The report will be sent automatically once the connection is back. You can close this window.
crash.banner: The program closed with an error last time. Send a report?

error.crash_offline: No connection to the server. The report will be sent automatically once the connection is back — you can close this window.
error.internal: Unexpected error while sending the report.

update.dismiss: Don't remind me about this version
update.busy: Available when the current task ends
update.retired_text: Changes to phones are blocked until you update.
update.confirm: AdMeNot will close, install {version} and start again. The journal, settings and backups stay.
update.dev: Development version — the download page will open.

error.update_download: Could not download the update. Check the connection and try again.
error.update_corrupt: The downloaded file is damaged or was replaced — try again.
error.update_launch_failed: Could not start the installer. Download it from: {page}
error.busy: Available when the current task ends.

close.message: Pause after the current step and close the program? The order can be finished or undone later.
close.after_step: Finishing the current step on the phone — the program will close by itself.

report.not_opened: Saved the report: {path} — could not open it (no program for this file). Open it manually.

transfer.reading: Checking what is on the phone…
transfer.reading_sub: Counting files, messages and apps. Nothing is changed on this phone.
transfer.title: What should be copied from the old phone?
transfer.sub: The selected data goes to this computer, then to the new phone. Nothing is changed on this phone.

row.contacts_note: The new phone opens an import — you pick the Google account.
row.sms_note: Including MMS attachments. RCS chats (“chat” in Google Messages) can't be copied over USB.
row.apps_note: Only the apps, without their data and sign-ins.

transfer.unreadable: The phone did not allow reading this data.
transfer.xiaomi_hint: On Xiaomi, Redmi and POCO phones, turn on “USB debugging (Security settings)” in Developer options, then choose “Transfer data” again. If the copy is already done, select only the missing data, e.g. SMS and contacts — the rest does not need to be copied again.

unreadable_files.one: {count} file or folder could not be read — it will not be in the copy
unreadable_files.few: {count} files or folders could not be read — they will not be in the copy
unreadable_files.many: {count} files or folders could not be read — they will not be in the copy
unreadable_files.other: {count} files or folders could not be read — they will not be in the copy

transfer.unreadable_files_text: The phone did not allow reading them (e.g. a damaged name or no access). The rest of the data is copied as usual.
transfer.whatsapp_old_title: The WhatsApp chat backup is older than an hour
transfer.whatsapp_none_title: There is no WhatsApp chat backup on the phone
transfer.whatsapp_old: Last chat backup on the phone: {when}. To get the latest messages, on the phone open WhatsApp → Settings → Chats → Chat backup → Back up.
transfer.whatsapp_none: To copy the messages, on the phone open WhatsApp → Settings → Chats → Chat backup → Back up.
transfer.no_space: Not enough disk space on this computer for this copy.
transfer.privacy: The copy contains the customer's private data. It is deleted automatically after 7 days — change that in History.
transfer.resume_text: Files already copied stay — the program finishes the rest.
transfer.copying: Copying data from the old phone
transfer.copying_sub: Keep the phone connected. If the cable disconnects, the copy waits and then continues.
transfer.waiting: Phone disconnected — reconnect it and the copy will continue
transfer.done_ok: Copy ready and verified — you can disconnect the old phone
transfer.done_warn: Copy ready, but not everything could be copied
transfer.done_warn_text: The data marked below is not in the copy.
transfer.done_stopped_text: Copied files stay on this computer. To finish, connect this phone and choose “Transfer data”.

expires.one: The copy is deleted from this computer in {count} day — change that in History.
expires.few: The copy is deleted from this computer in {count} days — change that in History.
expires.many: The copy is deleted from this computer in {count} days — change that in History.
expires.other: The copy is deleted from this computer in {count} days — change that in History.

transfer.delete_text: The customer's data in this copy is removed from this computer. This can't be undone.

error.retired: This version of AdMeNot is withdrawn — changes to phones are blocked until you update.
error.adb_missing: The adb program was not found. Point to adb.exe in the settings.
error.unauthorized: The phone is not authorized — confirm the prompt on the phone.
error.offline: The phone is offline — reconnect the cable.
error.timeout: The phone did not answer in time.
error.busy: Another task is running — wait for it to finish.
error.wrong_device: Connect the {device}, which this order is for.
error.device_mismatch: This is not the {device} from this order — another phone with the same serial number, or the phone after a factory reset. Changes from this order will not be made or undone on this phone.
error.no_device: Connect and scan a phone first.
error.nothing_to_resume: This order has no steps left to finish.
error.nothing_to_do: Nothing to run — the selected apps are blocked.

error.mirror_failed: Could not start the screen view.
error.shot_limit: You can choose at most 8 screenshots for the report.
